purpose: One fresh public-clip, fixed-input comparison of the original structured prompt and a stricter visible-only prompt. This is a protocol, not a performance claim.

fresh_public_source_slot.selection_rule: Choose one short official EPIC-KITCHENS public source by technical metadata before reading any action rows.
before_acquisition: confirm official HTTPS availability and applicable research license
record HEAD byte size and enforce the active acquisition cap
freeze source URL, SHA256 plan, source PTS span, and frame decode request before download
do not read action rows until raw outputs and blind visual review are frozen

fixed_inputs.frame_source: frames_fixed only, with immutable decoded frame IDs, exact source PTS, and hashes retained
fixed_inputs.selection_policy: Reserve the two uniform temporal anchors first; transparent luma-change ranking may fill only the one remaining window slot and may not replace anchors.
fixed_inputs.primary_window_rule: Preselect exactly one named window before inference; use that same immutable frame sequence in every prompt and control input.

inputs_per_prompt: same primary frames in source-forward order
the identical frames in source-reverse order
the first primary frame repeated losslessly
identical_runtime_and_control_contract.preflight_preprocessing_audit: Freeze installed MLX/Transformers versions, model revision, Qwen preprocessor patch/temporal/merge factors, RGB/rescale/normalization, resize/pixel settings, frame ordering, PTS, hashes, video_grid_thw, tensor shape, and merged tokens. Do not claim cross-runtime numerical parity from native tensors alone.

before_labels: retain raw model text and all invalid events
separately count schema-format failures, visually unsupported claims, visually supported claims, uncertainty, and abstention
record directly visible state/contact or motion observations separately from optional action hypotheses; frame IDs provide provenance, not independent proof
review forward/reverse for visible direction correspondence; reverse may legitimately describe a reversed visible action
require the repeated-identical-still input to abstain from temporal action claims
after_labels: independently record whether each reference action is human-observable in the actual sampled frames; never infer it from interval overlap
report model recognition or miss only after the first two fields, with precision and recall denominators stated
do not call any single clip, control pass, or abstention an accuracy or generalization result
prohibit: promotion of model hypotheses to accepted facts
